comment: Directory of bake-offs. Add one line per bake-off; the slug must match its folder name.

bakeoffs.title: Heat capacity model
bakeoffs.blurb: Fit the heat capacity C(T) from ten measurements, then predict outside the range you fitted on.

bakeoffs.title: Student final grade
bakeoffs.blurb: Predict a student's final maths grade from 30 features of school records and a survey, with a linear regression of your own design.
